blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Thornhill fell from 21 in June to 13 in October (−38.1%), and 8 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 3.4% of Maple Ridge’s 388 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Thornhill?
Thornhill also had 8 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in October, against 13 houses listed. The Thornhill condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Thornhill home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 houses sold in Thornhill with a median price of $1,292,250 (the middle half sold between $1,143,750 and $1,442,500), taking a median of 42 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $422 per square foot, a median year built of 2011 and a median lot of 4,312 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Thornhill?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Thornhill. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Thornhill a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Thornhill had a sales ratio of not published for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Thornhill from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in Thornhill over those 5 months, out of 247 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Thornhill?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Thornhill sell for?
faq.a: 14 houses sold in Thornhill between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,292,250.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Thornhill?
faq.a: The median was 42 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.8% of the last list price (7% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
